set.body:
Outcome: the frozen E1 study has an admitted, complete evaluation manifest and independently coded reference that the execution path can consume without development access to sealed labels.

Acceptance:
1. Existing owner resource/protocol ticket bd-01M2TA0X79Y4BQZP0B6AT919C9 records actual coder availability and approved material/host/basis. Planning authorization is not recruitment, payment, corpus access or hosted transmission permission. Scope the resource decision to this study; do not recruit or spend implicitly.
2. Coders are blind to model outputs and other coders as the frozen protocol requires; instructions permit ambiguous/multiple occurrences and real reversals/revisits rather than enforcing chronology. Record disagreements and adjudication policy. A second coder's labels are not automatically ground truth.
3. Before execution, independently audit all eligibility, inventory and split/exposure identities, missing labels and the sample-size/precision requirement. Preserve the full requested denominator. No evaluation unit was used for parameter, prompt, threshold or branch selection.
4. Store participant text/labels only in approved private storage; repository receipts contain permissible hashes, aggregate counts and protocol identities. Automated contamination and tampering controls fail for duplicated/overlapping identities, omitted hard cases and changed label versions.

Next action after E1/resources: prepare and independently audit the blinded packet. If authorized fresh material or coders are unavailable, mark this slice blocked with the exact resource needed; continue engineering and synthetic recovery separately. Never substitute already opened examples for prospective evidence.

Evidence and completion: keep exact baseline/candidate SHA, input and artifact hashes, literal commands and actual exits, passed/failed/skipped totals, initial adverse evidence, and independent exact-SHA review. Runtime changes use tools/reference-scope.sh in a clean standalone clone, fatal warnings, all affected platforms and the pinned StoryAtlas consumer where consumed; formatting runs last. Documentation/tracker-only changes use a format/integrity check and cold review (T2). One primary writer, one helper and one heavy gate at a time. Claim only the slice and reserve its narrow paths. No percentage-complete or efficacy claim follows from ticket/test counts.
set.title: [reality-check E2] Prepare blinded evaluation labels and verify exposure eligibility
